title: Subscriptions
subtitle: Newsletters and mailing lists that write to you. Leave the ones you never read.

intro.title: Find what you never read
intro.text: Ordo reads your latest {{count, number}} messages (only senders and headers) and lists the senders you can unsubscribe from.

none.title: No subscriptions found
none.text: Nothing in your latest messages offers a way to unsubscribe.

methods.oneClick: Unsubscribes right here in one click
methods.link: Opens their unsubscribe page in your browser
methods.mail: Opens an unsubscribe email in your mail app

left.link: {{name}}: finish on the page that just opened
left.mail: {{name}}: send the email that just opened

trashed_one: {{count, number}} message from {{name}} moved to the trash
trashed_other: {{count, number}} messages from {{name}} moved to the trash
blocked: New mail from {{name}} now goes straight to the trash
note: Unsubscribing uses the link each sender includes: one click ones finish here, the rest open their page or an email. Block adds a Gmail filter that sends new mail to the trash, under the “Blocked” label.
